label: Homicides Since Sep 9, 2024
contestNote: Noroeste updated its cumulative conflict tally (June 6, 2026) to 3,353 homicides, 3,957 kidnappings, and 11,423 vehicle thefts since Sep 9, 2024 — attributed to the Guzmán-Zambada faction dispute. This figure is higher than the previous 2,560 count (which reflected only battlefield-classified deaths) and now aligns with the WSJ's May 17 estimate of 3,000+ killed. Official SNSP data remains lower. NGO Sabuesos Unidas: ~5,800 disappearances since Sep 2024. June 3: Culiacán records 10 homicides in one day; 30 in 72 hours — Army airlifts 90 Murciélagos. June 4: Defense Secretary + National Guard Commander emergency visit to Culiacán. June 5: FGR contradicts Sheinbaum on Interpol Red Notice for Rocha Moya. June 6: Two more targeted killings in Culiacán; Escuinapa enters 14th consecutive day of gunfire.
deltaNote: Noroeste June 6 cumulative count: 3,353 homicides since Sep 9, 2024 — revised upward from 2,560 to include all violence classified as faction-dispute-attributable.
